jobs.title: Frisco Corporate Security Officer – Elite Patrol & Service
jobs.description:
Sunstates Security, LLC is seeking a Corporate Security Officer for our Frisco campus. This is a full-time, on-site, unarmed role starting at $22.66 per hour. The officer will patrol interior and exterior areas, monitor access, assist employees and visitors, and report incidents with professionalism.

Candidates should have a Texas Level II Security License and reliable transportation. Corporate security or related experience is preferred but not required.

jobs.title: Corporate Security Pro: Safeguard People & Assets
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is hiring a Corporate Security Specialist. This role provides physical security coverage at assigned corporate office locations to ensure protection of client employees, visitors, property, and equipment, and interacts professionally with employees and guests.

Responsibilities include watching for irregularities, responding to incidents, patrolling areas, preparing routine reports, providing escorts, and performing equipment checks such as AEDs and extinguishers.
